notes:
Each receipt is named after its own guest. On a changeover day a room has two guests, and a receipt under the new one no longer borrows the name of the room's first receipt; a name the report cut is still completed from protel's in-house list, and only a receipt with too little of a name to say whose it is takes the room's.

With 1.17.46: the panel is ARRIVALS, DEPARTURES, MOVES with no turnover group; the dot and the LEAVING TODAY mark take a receipt whose name opens the departing guest's; names refresh in place when the in-house list is captured; the cards and rows show the whole name.
